What Happens If You Step on Jupiter? (No Floor!) — You step out of your spaceship onto Jupiter—wait, where did the ground go?!
Kids science answer for "can you stand on jupiter for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Jupiter is a giant gas planet of hydrogen and helium with no rocky ground to stand on; gravity and pressure crush deeper layers inward.
